description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) VICTORY BEFORE DEATH (Grav-Assault Force, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Shooting phase); the Caladius Grav-tank (1 wound left) stands on obj_home_2 (P2 controls it — objective control recomputed), the Gretchin 7" away. The Ork Gretchin shoot the Caladius (seeded SHOOT actions until it is destroyed): unit_destroyed opens for P2; a real click on 'Use on Caladius...' asks which objective it was in range of; a real click on obj_home_2 spends 1 CP: the objective stays under P2's control.

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined

steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
var H = load("res://tests/helpers/cus11e_c5_scen.gd")
var killed := false
for sd in [3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23]:
	H.shoot(1, "U_GRETCHIN_C", "U_CALADIUS_A", "", sd)
	if H.window_id() == "unit_destroyed" or not H.unit("U_CALADIUS_A").models[0].get("alive", true):
		killed = true
		break
	var g := 0
	while H.window_id() != "" and H.window_id() != "unit_destroyed" and g < 6:
		var w = H.phase().get_pending_stratagem_window()
		H.phase().execute_action({"type": "DECLINE_WINDOW_STRATAGEM", "player": int(w.player), "window_id": str(w.window_id)})
		g += 1
	H.phase().units_that_shot.erase("U_GRETCHIN_C")
	H.unit("U_GRETCHIN_C").flags.erase("has_shot")
	print("[cus11e vbd] seed ", sd, " did not destroy the Caladius")
return killed
steps.comment: the Gretchin shoot the Caladius (the panel's SHOOT; re-tried with fresh seeds until it dies — setup privilege)
REAL click on the stratagem's Use button
REAL click on the secondary pick
the Game Log names the stratagem
